scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: A pretend browser page flashes a red warning while Meera reads a club article. It claims hundreds of problems and offers a repair button. Kabir notices that the warning is part of the webpage, not a diagnosis from the school’s approved device support.
scenes.speech: A pretend browser page flashes a red warning while Meera reads a club article. It claims hundreds of problems and offers a repair button. Kabir notices that the warning is part of the webpage, not a diagnosis from the school’s approved device support.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: An alarming claim can push a learner to download a program, call an unfamiliar number or allow remote control. These actions may give someone more access. A loud warning does not make the claimed diagnosis true or make the advertised helper trustworthy.
scenes.speech: An alarming claim can push a learner to download a program, call an unfamiliar number or allow remote control. These actions may give someone more access. A loud warning does not make the claimed diagnosis true or make the advertised helper trustworthy.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The teacher practises stepping away from the page without pressing its repair controls. Students ask for help and use the school’s known support process. They do not test the warning by installing anything, paying a fee or handing over the device during this fictional lesson.
scenes.speech: The teacher practises stepping away from the page without pressing its repair controls. Students ask for help and use the school’s known support process. They do not test the warning by installing anything, paying a fee or handing over the device during this fictional lesson.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The claim appears inside an article page and asks for a download. No trusted adult has confirmed a device problem. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The claim appears inside an article page and asks for a download. No trusted adult has confirmed a device problem. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Should Meera press the advertised repair button?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Pause and ask the teacher through known support. Do not use the page’s download or remote-control offer as proof that its alarming claim is correct.
scenes.speech: Pause and ask the teacher through known support. Do not use the page’s download or remote-control offer as proof that its alarming claim is correct.
scenes.dialogue: Identify payment, download and remote-access demands.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through alarming claims, then access demands, then known device help. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
